notes: Restaurant counts by market come from McDonald's 'Restaurants by Market 2025' PDF (investor relations; year-end 2025, 45,356 restaurants); 97 markets covering 114 countries. Several markets consolidate other countries: United States includes Cuba, Guam and Saipan; Australia includes American Samoa, Fiji, New Caledonia, Tahiti and Western Samoa; France includes Monaco; Spain includes Andorra and Gibraltar; Switzerland includes Liechtenstein; United Kingdom includes the Isle of Man, Jersey, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales. 'St. Marten' and 'Virgin Islands' are kept as unnamed-country regions because the document does not say which territory (Dutch Sint Maarten vs. French Saint-Martin; U.S. vs. British Virgin Islands) is meant. Sri Lanka, which showed 0 restaurants at year-end 2024, is no longer listed in the 2025 edition, so its row was removed. No restaurant count by U.S. state was found in the FY2025 10-K or in the restaurant-count document, so usStates is null. The FY2025 10-K says company employees totaled over 150,000 at year-end 2025, about 70% outside the U.S.; no country split was derived. Segment subtotals (IOM 10,845; IDL 20,805) were not repeated as regions.
